question: Can the sealed proof-carrying chain machine transport at least one genuine bit of boundary constraint information under a fixed four-state unary payload alphabet, while preserving composition, constructive return, source validation and polynomial size/time?

frozen_exact_syntax.boundary_variables: q_j = 2 + 30*j for inter-block cut j=1..g-1; q_j is exactly the variable surviving the preceding sealed MID projection
frozen_exact_syntax.payload_vector: sigma=(sigma_1,...,sigma_(g-1)), sigma_j in Sigma_1; for g=1 the vector is empty
frozen_exact_syntax.generalized_instance: F_{g,sigma}=canonical(F_g union payload_CNF(sigma_j,q_j) for all inter-block boundaries j)

frozen_residual_state_semantics.equivalence: a ~ b iff for every allowed unary continuation K on the same cut, SAT(a AND K)=SAT(b AND K)
frozen_residual_state_semantics.distinguishability_requirement: FORCE_0 and FORCE_1 must be separated by explicit K_0,K_1 witnesses; labels do not count
frozen_residual_state_semantics.information_capacity: N_boundary is the number of residual-behaviour equivalence classes actually realized by the generalized MID relation

frozen_local_composition_definition.incoming_state: rho_j in Sigma_1 summarizes the already-eliminated prefix as a unary residual on q_j
frozen_local_composition_definition.local_payload: sigma_j in Sigma_1 is conjoined on q_j
frozen_local_composition_definition.unit_relation: R_U(q_j,p_j) is the exact existential endpoint relation of sealed U between x2 and x30
frozen_local_composition_definition.next_payload: tau in Sigma_1 is conjoined on q_(j+1)
frozen_local_composition_definition.COMPOSE_SIGMA: the unique unary residual on q_(j+1) obtained by existentially eliminating q_j,p_j from rho_j(q_j) AND payload(sigma_j,q_j) AND R_U(q_j,p_j) AND B_j(p_j,q_(j+1)) and then conjoining payload(tau,q_(j+1)); classify the resulting unary truth table into Sigma_1, or emit CLOSURE_FALSIFIER if it is outside Sigma_1
frozen_local_composition_definition.uniformity: same operator for every j and every g; no tested-g lookup, no future-answer choice

required_checks.BA1_1: prove FORCE_0 != FORCE_1 by explicit continuations
required_checks.BA1_2: compute full four-state COMPOSE_SIGMA closure table from exact endpoint relation and bridge semantics
required_checks.BA1_3: verify whether an informative incoming residual remains semantically distinguishable after generic composition; SAT-only preservation is insufficient
required_checks.BA1_5: for every SAT generalized instance reconstructed model must satisfy original F_{g,sigma} and every FORCE payload
required_checks.BA1_6: separate trivial BOTTOM UNSAT from nontrivial propagated contradiction
required_checks.BA1_7: derive n,s,t recurrences and reject duplicated exponential history
required_checks.BA1_8: compute exact N_boundary and log2 capacity from semantic equivalence classes

frozen_size_time_accounting.n: literal count of target CNF including payload clauses; empty BOTTOM clause contributes zero literals but one clause and is tracked separately
frozen_size_time_accounting.s: proof-carrying relation/certificate rows plus explicit payload-state records; DAG references count once but referenced content must remain independently verifiable
frozen_size_time_accounting.t: construction + relation verification + decision + reconstruction + direct source validation
frozen_size_time_accounting.history_duplication_firewall: CACHED_HASH_REFERENCE != PROOF_CONTENT; recursive certificate byte duplication is forbidden

falsifiers.F2: four-state residual algebra is not closed
falsifiers.F3: SAT is preserved but incoming residual requirement is erased by generic composition
falsifiers.F7: independent verifier cannot reconstruct payload semantics
falsifiers.F8: only UNSAT capability is direct insertion of BOTTOM and no nontrivial propagated contradiction exists
falsifiers.F9: generic rule depends on a finite tested-g table
falsifiers.F10: neutral TOP case is not exactly sealed F_g

promotion_rule: BA1-A requires N_boundary>=2 and generic preservation of the informative residual state across composition, not merely local distinguishability at an externally injected cut
